status: DRAFT: not yet exercised with real hardware
description: One row per logged frame of the ASTRA-66 flight computer. Field order below is the CSV column order. Empty CSV cell / JSON null = no fresh sample in this frame or value rejected by validation.

data_sources.SYNTHETIC: Computer-generated (simulated sensors or a truth profile). Not flight data and not a prediction.
data_sources.BENCH: Recorded from real hardware on the bench (electronics only; the vehicle is not flying).
data_sources.FLIGHT: Recorded in flight. Disabled in software: no real flight record exists and nothing has flown.
data_sources.SIMULATED: Legacy label of the Phase 4 datasets; same meaning as SYNTHETIC.
data_sources.HARDWARE: Legacy label reserved in Phase 4 for real sensors; treated as BENCH.

conventions.time: timestamp = seconds since the flight computer's clock start, from a microsecond counter (unwrapped if 32-bit).
conventions.body_frame: +z along the rocket axis toward the nose; x and y radial, right-handed. The sensor-to-body mapping is set when the IMU and its mounting are selected.
conventions.specific_force: Accelerometers measure specific force (acceleration minus gravity): about +9.81 m/s² on +z when standing on the pad.
conventions.altitude: altitude = barometric altitude above the pad reference pressure (ISA formula). gps_altitude = GNSS altitude above mean sea level.
conventions.freshness: Slow sensors (GNSS, temperature, battery) are written only in frames where a new sample arrived; other frames leave them empty.
conventions.valid_range: Plausibility limits used by validation. They are NOT sensor specifications. Values outside are rejected (set empty) and flagged in quality_flags.

sampling.note: The committed example is logged at 50 Hz to keep the repository small; the hardware target is >= 100 Hz IMU to SD (engineering package §8).

quality_flag_bits.6: timestamp anomaly (gap larger than 3 nominal periods before this frame)

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Frame counter, +1 per logged frame (gaps reveal lost frames).

fields.name: data_source
fields.description: Where the data came from (avionics/firmware/data_source.py). SYNTHETIC / BENCH / FLIGHT; SIMULATED and HARDWARE are the legacy Phase 4 labels for SYNTHETIC and BENCH. Synthetic or bench data must never be presented as flight data.

fields.name: flight_state
fields.description: Data-processing label only. Not connected to any actuator.

fields.name: imu_accel_z
fields.description: Specific force, body z (axial, toward the nose).

fields.name: altitude
fields.description: Barometric altitude above the pad reference (ISA).

fields.name: vertical_velocity
fields.description: Estimated vertical velocity (Kalman filter: accelerometer + barometer; barometer only after apogee).

fields.name: gps_altitude
fields.description: GNSS altitude above mean sea level.

fields.name: crc16
fields.description: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE of the preceding CSV fields of this row (as written, comma-joined). Detects corrupted rows.
